title: Memo on backup retention, defective draft (fictional)
text: Under section 4, a controller must delete customer records within 90 days of account closure. In Arden Logistics v. Corvo Systems, the court held that retention policies always apply to archived backups. Policy DR-3 states that archived backups are retained for one year. Bexley Storage v. Marr reached the same result in 2024. This clearly settles the question, so no further review is needed.

sources.title: Fictional Data Retention Act, section 4
sources.text: Section 4. A controller must delete customer records within 90 days of account closure, unless a written legal hold applies.

sources.title: Arden Logistics v. Corvo Systems (fictional, 2025)
sources.text: In Arden Logistics v. Corvo Systems, the court held that a retention policy applied to archived backups only if the policy said so expressly.

sources.title: Client policy DR-3
sources.text: Policy DR-3. Archived backups are retained for one year.
